messages:
Ben: FYI - Atlas private deployment window is tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please ack if you're on the rota for smoke/rollback readiness.
Maya: I'm on call for smoke tests. I'll run the API sanity checklist and perf probes.
Chandra: I'll handle infra cutover (firewall + routing). Will be online 01:30 UTC for prechecks.
Nina: I'll own rollback if anything goes sideways — I have the revert tag ready: tags/atlas-v1.4.2-rollback.
Ben: Good. No DB migrations in this slot, right?
Alex: Confirmed — config-only change and model weights swap from s3://redwood-atlas/models/v1.4.2 to v1.4.3. No schema changes.
Maya: Smoke plan (quick):
```
1) curl -f https://atlas.private.healthz -H 'x-rw-tenant: atlas'
2) run loadgen 30s @ 10rps targeting /generate
3) sample 10 responses, check token counts and latency < 250ms p50
```
Chandra: Networking checklist: NAT rules applied, peering up, security group has port 443 open only from customer CIDR. I'll paste diffs during prep.
Ben: @Nina what's the expected rollback time SLA? We should have a target < 15m for full revert.
Nina: Aim for 10-12m. Steps: disable new model, restore old symlink, restart service pods with rollout pause for health. I tested locally.
Maya: @deploy-bot can you run the preflight now and post results?
deploy-bot: Preflight started. Missing item: monitoring alert runbook link not attached to the deployment. Please attach runbook: https://confluence.redwood/infradev/atlas-runbook
Ben: I'll attach the runbook in 5m. Also adding contact numbers: Maya +1-415-555-0123, Chandra +1-650-555-0189, Nina +1-650-555-0246.
Alex: Quick note: KV cache warming will happen during rollout; expect a small latency blip for first 50 requests. We have autoscale to cover it.
Maya: I'll keep the smoke thread open and post a short pass/fail at T+10m after rollout starts.
Chandra: Preflight done from my side. Peering health OK. Security group verified.
deploy-bot: Preflight complete. All checks passed except: runbook link missing (attached now).
Ben: All set. Final check — anyone want to move the window by +30m? No? Then we proceed tomorrow 02:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Nina: No objections. I'll be at my laptop.
Alex: LGTM.
Maya: Good luck team. I'll post the smoke results in this thread. :rocket:
